description.value: Butter Lane Bake Shop is a North Vancouver bakery founded in 2014 and specializing in custom cakes for weddings, birthdays, and celebrations, alongside savoury catering and dessert bars. The shop operates from two locations: a dedicated bakery at 175 W 3rd St and a stall inside the Lonsdale Quay Market. Cyclists passing through the Lonsdale area or the Lower Lonsdale neighbourhood can stop in for freshly baked pastries and sweets.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces) at 34m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 64m; stands (4 spaces) at 88m. Total: 24 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loaded and provides authoritative contact details: address at 101-175 W 3rd St, North Vancouver and phone (604)922-4472 from the /contact page. The business is clearly open and active, with multiple product pages and ordering functionality. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced exclusively from the website /contact page.
Website front page states the business is 'based in Vancouver' while the contact page lists a North Vancouver address — minor inconsistency, likely informal language rather than a location error.
Business operates two locations (175 W 3rd St and Lonsdale Quay Market); the OSM node coordinates should be verified to confirm which location they represent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active bakery with a confirmed North Vancouver address and functioning website; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking baked goods or a rest near Lonsdale Quay.
enrichment_extras.notes: Second location inside Lonsdale Quay Market is open 7 days a week per the /contact page, which may be more convenient for cyclists on the seawall route.
